known_defect.cause: _CODE_HINTS matches 'not in scope' and 'khong thuoc'; the guard emits 'is not part of this dashboard.' which matches nothing and falls through to the default
known_defect.status: snapshotted as-is on purpose. V3.0 must not change behaviour; this is the first item for the error-taxonomy fix, and the replay harness will prove that fix changes exactly this and nothing else
known_defect.what: assert_chart_in_scope refuses correctly, but result.classify() maps its message to query_failed instead of chart_out_of_scope
known_defect.why_it_matters: query_failed's documented recovery is 'retry the query', so a model retries a call that can never succeed, and the chart_out_of_scope recovery hint (search_business_assets / resolve_chart_candidates) never reaches it
